from pyspark.sql.functions import * # collect_list, struct, explode, col,schema_of_json, from_json, to_json
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient, BlobClient, ContainerClient
import datetime
import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql import Row
import pandas as pd
import json
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, when, lit, concat_ws, collect_list, sum as spark_sum

# get the function to retrieve sql properties
%run Utility/getSQLConnectionString

# retrieve sql connection_string and connection_properties
jdbcUrl,conn_Prop = getSQLConnectionString()

def should_run_job():
    today = datetime.datetime.today()
    # Controlla se è il 14 e se il mese è uno di quelli specificati
    return today.day == 14 and today.month in [1, 4, 7, 10]
    # return True

# Esegui il job solo se la condizione è soddisfatta
if should_run_job():

    LinkedServiceNameBlobStorageCRM = 'crmpdatast'

    # Calcolo del trimestre precedente
    current_date = datetime.datetime.now()
    current_month = current_date.month
    current_year = current_date.year

    # current_date = datetime.datetime(2025, 4, 14)
    # current_month = current_date.month
    # current_year = current_date.year

    if 1 <= current_month <= 3:
        previous_quarter = f"{current_year - 1}_4"
    elif 4 <= current_month <= 6:
        previous_quarter = f"{current_year}_1"
    elif 7 <= current_month <= 9:
        previous_quarter = f"{current_year}_2"
    else:
        previous_quarter = f"{current_year}_3"

    print(f"Trimestre precedente: {previous_quarter}")

    query_psp_cumulo_fattura=f"""(SELECT 
                                    recipient_id,
                                    year_quarter,
                                    STRING_AGG(
                                        CASE 
                                            WHEN LEN(c2.tax_code) = 12 AND SUBSTRING(c2.tax_code, 2, 12) = c2.tax_code 
                                                THEN SUBSTRING(c2.tax_code, 2, 12)
                                            WHEN LEN(c2.tax_code) = 12 AND SUBSTRING(c2.tax_code, 1, 11) = c2.tax_code 
                                                THEN SUBSTRING(c2.tax_code, 1, 11)
                                            ELSE c2.tax_code 
                                        END, ','
                                    ) AS pspInCumuloFattura
                                FROM ppa.Contracts c2
                                GROUP BY recipient_id, year_quarter) as pspData"""

    spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_psp_cumulo_fattura, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("pspData")


    query_aggregazione_articoli=f"""(SELECT fr2.abi, fr2.year_quarter,
                                    STRING_AGG(fr2.codice_articolo, ',')  AS articoli
                                    FROM ppa.FinancialReports fr2
                                    WHERE fr2.codice_articolo NOT IN ('BOLLO')
                                    AND fr2.year_quarter = '{previous_quarter}'
                                    GROUP BY fr2.abi, fr2.year_quarter) as AggregazioneArticoli"""

    spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_aggregazione_articoli, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("AggregazioneArticoli")

    query_contratti=f"""(SELECT DISTINCT c.abi, CASE 
            WHEN LEN(c.tax_code)=12 AND SUBSTRING(c.tax_code, 2, 12)=c.tax_code THEN SUBSTRING(c.tax_code, 2, 12)
            WHEN LEN(c.tax_code)=12 AND SUBSTRING(c.tax_code, 1, 11)=c.tax_code THEN SUBSTRING(c.tax_code, 1, 11)
        ELSE c.tax_code END AS codiceFiscale
        FROM ppa.Contracts c) as Contratti"""

    spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_contratti, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("Contratti")

    query_contracts=f"""(SELECT * FROM ppa.Contracts c) as Contratti"""

    spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_contracts, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("Contracts")

    query_fr=f"""(SELECT * from ppa.FinancialReports) as FinancialReports"""

    spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_fr, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("FinancialReports")

    financial_reports = spark.read.table("FinancialReports")

    # Filtra gli articoli esclusi
    codici_articolo_df = (
        financial_reports
        .select("codice_articolo")
        .distinct()
        .filter(~col("codice_articolo").isin(["BOLLO"]))
    )

    # Estrai i codici articolo unici come lista
    codici_articolo = [row["codice_articolo"] for row in codici_articolo_df.collect()]

    # Genera dinamicamente le colonne SUM(...) AS fatturato_X
    temp_columns1 = ", ".join(
        [f"SUM(CASE WHEN fr.codice_articolo = '{art}' THEN fr.value ELSE 0 END) AS fatturato_{art.replace('.', '')}"
        for art in codici_articolo]
    )

    # Genera dinamicamente le colonne SUM(...) AS transazioni_X
    temp_columns2 = ", ".join(
        [f"SUM(CASE WHEN fr.codice_articolo = '{art}' THEN fr.current_trx ELSE 0 END) AS transazioni_{art.replace('.', '')}"
        for art in codici_articolo]
    )


    query_totale=f"""SELECT SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 1, 4) AS anno, 
                        CASE 
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '1' THEN '3'
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '2' THEN '6'
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '3' THEN '9'
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '4' THEN '12'
                        END AS mese, 
                        c.codiceFiscale,
                        aa.articoli,
                        {temp_columns1}, 
                        {temp_columns2}, 
                        -- SUM(SUM(fr.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.codiceFiscale, fr.year_quarter) AS fatturato,
                        p.pspInCumuloFattura as pspInCumuloFattura
                    FROM FinancialReports fr
                    LEFT JOIN Contratti c ON fr.abi = c.abi
                    LEFT JOIN AggregazioneArticoli aa ON fr.abi = aa.abi AND fr.year_quarter = aa.year_quarter
                    LEFT JOIN pspData p ON fr.recipient_id = p.recipient_id AND fr.year_quarter = p.year_quarter 
                    WHERE 
                        fr.codice_articolo NOT IN ('BOLLO') 
                        AND fr.year_quarter = '{previous_quarter}' 
                    GROUP BY 
                        SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 1, 4),
                        CASE 
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '1' THEN '3'
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '2' THEN '6'
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '3' THEN '9'
                            WHEN SUBSTRING(fr.year_quarter, 6, 1) = '4' THEN '12'
                        END,
                        c.codiceFiscale,
                        aa.articoli,
                        p.pspInCumuloFattura,
                        fr.year_quarter
                    ORDER BY 
                        anno, mese, c.codiceFiscale""" 

    pandas_df = spark.sql(query_totale)


    json_rdd = pandas_df.toJSON().collect()  
    json  = "[" + ",".join(json_rdd) + "]" 

    display("Avvio il caricamento")

    blob_name = "fatturato_pagopa_"+current_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M")+".json"
    url = "https://crmpdatast.blob.core.windows.net"
    shared_access_key = mssparkutils.credentials.getConnectionStringOrCreds(LinkedServiceNameBlobStorageCRM)
    container_name = "data"

    try:
        blob_service_client = BlobServiceClient(url, credential=shared_access_key)
            
        blob_client = blob_service_client.get_blob_client(container=container_name, blob=blob_name)
            
        blob_client.upload_blob(json, overwrite=True)
            
        print(f"I dati sono stati salvati con successo in {blob_name} nel container {container_name}.")

    except Exception as e:
            print(f"Errore durante il caricamento di {blob_name}: {e}")
else:
     print(f"L'esecuzione è prevista solo a valle del quarter di fatturazione.")
